#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 998244353LL;

vector<ll> fact;
vector<ll> invFact;

ll mult(ll a, ll b) {
    return a * b % MOD;
}

ll mult(ll a, ll b, ll c) {
    return mult(mult(a, b), c);
}

ll add(ll a, ll b) {
    ll v = a + b;
    return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
}

ll subtract(ll a, ll b) {
    ll v = a - b;
    return v < 0 ? v + MOD : v;
}

ll inv(ll a) {
    ll g = MOD, x = 0, y = 1;
    for (ll r = a; r != 0; ) {
        ll q = g / r;
        g %= r;
        swap(g, r);
        x -= q * y;
        swap(x, y);
    }
    if (g != 1) throw logic_error("Assertion error");
    x %= MOD;
    if (x < 0) x += MOD;
    return x;
}

void init(int max) {
    fact.resize(max + 1);
    invFact.resize(max + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= max; i++) fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % MOD;
    invFact[max] = inv(fact[max]);
    for (int i = max; i >= 1; i--) invFact[i-1] = invFact[i] * i % MOD;
}

ll ncr(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
    return mult(fact[n], invFact[r], invFact[n - r]);
}

ll smallInv(int x) {
    return mult(invFact[x], fact[x-1]);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    init(n + m);

    ll phaseSize = 1;
    ll p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = mult(p, n - i, smallInv(n + m - i));
        phaseSize = add(phaseSize, p);
    }

    ll answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        ll numPhases = mult(m + k, smallInv(k));
        ll term = mult(ncr(n, k), numPhases, phaseSize);
        if ((k & 1) == 1) answer = add(answer, term);
        else answer = subtract(answer, term);
    }

    cout << answer << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
